alternatives_rejected.why: Injected delay would not usually drive CPU up 655.6% (z=67.44). The own-span slowdown alongside that CPU spike points to compute saturation (E1, E2).
Frontend latency-50 rose only 29.5% (z=5.89), while recommendationservice latency-90 rose 867.2% (z=173.44). The anomaly is far stronger downstream, so frontend is a victim, not the source (E1).

proposed_fix.description: Check recommendationservice for runaway CPU consumers such as a hot loop or a stress process, and kill them. Scale out or raise the CPU limits for recommendationservice, then confirm its latency returns to baseline.
